_comment: Every link names its destination in exactly one way, so each URL is written down once, in the file that owns it. "href" is a page the brand layer hosts, written as its path on typhed.com (index.ts expands it against site.json's url, so the header and the footer reach the same page from a product subdomain), a full URL with "external": true, a mailto:, or "#" until the page exists. "property" names a property in properties.json and takes its URL, opening in a new tab unless it is the brand site. "social" names an entry of the social list by its icon and takes that account's URL. The social mail entry takes its address from contactEmail, the copyright template fills {name} and {tagline} from site.json, and the header's first link, to the brand hub, is built from site.json too, so it is not listed under nav. An entry whose reference names nothing stops the build.

disclaimer._comment: Privacy Policy is not repeated here. The `privacy` entry below is its one source, and index.ts prepends it to this column so the column and the bottom bar can never point at different pages.
